items.title: Moderna's Q3 Numbers May Have Seemed Impressive, but They Aren't Enough to Make the Stock a Buy
items.summary: Revenue for the vaccine maker rose sharply in the third quarter, but it was largely due to COVID sales, which have been down significantly over the past five years.

items.title: Is Moderna (MRNA) Priced For Too Much Sales Growth?
items.summary: Moderna has turned into one of the market’s sharpest movers, and after such a powerful run, the key issue for you is whether the current share price still lines up with what its sales can support. A stock can move very quickly when sentiment swings on new data or approvals, so the question is how that rapid repricing stacks up against the revenue Moderna is generating today and what investors expect it to produce next. items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Stock Fair Value Rises After Intismeran Data And Q3 Beat
items.summary: Analysts have lifted their fair value estimate for Moderna from US$135.84 to US$145.42 per share, signaling a reset in how the stock is being framed. Much of this shift ties back to the debate over intismeran oncology potential, Q3 execution, and how much future COVID and oncology revenue is already reflected in current pricing. items.title: SanDisk's 64% collapse: another leg down or buying opportunity?
items.summary: SanDisk’s steep decline has investors weighing whether the worst is over or another selloff lies ahead.

items.title: Can Moderna's First Cancer Therapy Win FDA Approval in 2027?
items.summary: MRNA targets a year-end 2026 FDA filing for its personalized cancer therapy, intismeran, potentially paving the way for a regulatory decision in 2027.

items.title: Moderna Soars Another 9% as Piper Sandler Lifts Target to $305 on Raised Outlook
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna jumped 9% after Piper Sandler raised its price target to $305 from $230, following Friday’s third-quarter beat. Piper’s target bets on the melanoma vaccine Moderna is developing with Merck, a win investors already pay a lot for.

items.title: MRNA support and resistance levels to watch

items.title: Moderna Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Raised Outlook and Oncology
items.summary: MRNA raises its 2026 revenue growth outlook after strong Q3 results, lower costs and respiratory vaccine gains, while advancing its oncology pipeline.
